task: On Apple's website, how many different types of keyboards are available when customizing your 14-inch MacBook Pro?
final_answer:
Based on my investigation of the Apple website, I can now provide the answer.

## Answer

When customizing the 14-inch MacBook Pro on Apple's website, **20 different types of keyboards** are available.

The customization section explicitly shows:
- **Keyboard**: "Choose from 20 languages"

This appears under the Customizations panel for the 14-inch MacBook Pro (which starts from $1999), alongside other customization options like Unified Memory, SSD Storage, and Power Adapter (which has only 3 options). The 20 keyboard options correspond to different language layouts/regional keyboards you can choose for your MacBook Pro.
